about_short_description.short_description: Syrona Health is a digital health solution for personalised gynaecology across life-stages starting from Endometriosis to Menopause.

product.name: Syrona Health Platform
product.description: A digital health platform providing personalised virtual healthcare support for gynaecological and related health conditions across various life stages.

product.name: Virtual Consultations
product.description: One-to-one virtual sessions with qualified health experts for personalised diagnosis and treatment guidance.

product.name: At-Home Diagnostic Testing Kits
product.description: Diagnostic test kits that users can perform at home to assist in early detection and diagnosis of health conditions.

product.name: Symptom and Health Tracking Tools
product.description: Digital tools for logging symptoms and lifestyle data to monitor health status and inform personalised care plans.

product.name: Personalised Care Plans
product.description: Tailored healthcare plans based on individual symptoms and lifestyle data to guide treatment and management.

product.name: On-Demand Educational Resources
product.description: Access to medically reviewed articles, videos, and live events related to gynaecological and life-stage health topics.
